style_rules: Lead with the business benefit, then the service.
Short, clear sentences. No jargon without a benefit next to it.
Speak to UAE businesses; mention Dubai/UAE naturally, not in every sentence.
End with one clear call to action (call, WhatsApp, email or website).
Emojis: at most 2-3 on Facebook, 0-1 on X and Threads. Tasteful ones only (e.g. ✅ 📞 🌐 🚀 🔒).
avoid: Hype words like 'revolutionary', 'best in the world', 'guaranteed'.
Invented numbers, prices, discounts, client names, awards or certifications.
Political or religious commentary (festival greetings are fine when requested).
Spelling the domain as amanasoft.net - the correct website is amanasoft.ae.

safe_to_use: Based in Dubai, serving businesses across the UAE
End-to-end service: consultation, design, installation, testing and support
do_not_use_until_confirmed: Years of experience (website says 20 years - confirm with client)
Project and client counts (website shows 187 happy clients, 217 finished projects, and elsewhere 875 completed projects - inconsistent)

look_and_feel: Modern corporate-tech: blue-to-purple gradients, flowing wave shapes, subtle dot and plus-sign decorations.
Bold uppercase headline with ONE power word highlighted in yellow (#F8D04A).
Realistic, high-quality technology photography: server racks, fiber and copper cabling, network switches, CCTV, engineers at work, modern Dubai offices, Dubai skyline.

Premium night posters (like the client's 'AI-Driven Networks' sample): Dubai skyline under a starry sky, a UAE flag (drawn by our designer, never by the AI), big gradient headline and a short benefit paragraph.
Lighting in cool blue, cyan and violet tones with small warm yellow accents.
Logo always the original file, never redrawn. Contact footer always present.
Every post states a customer problem or goal, the solution and 3 concrete benefits. No call-to-action buttons on the image; calls to action go in the captions.
visual.photo_style_prompt: ultra-realistic professional commercial photography, cinematic lighting, cool blue, cyan and violet color grading with subtle warm yellow accents, shallow depth of field, crisp detail, premium corporate technology aesthetic
avoid_in_images: any text, letters, numbers, labels or signage
logos or brand marks of any company
messy tangled cables (unless showing a 'before' problem)
flags (the designer adds the UAE flag itself where needed)
